Hazardous areas are spaces where flammable or explosive gases, vapors or dust are normally present, or
likely to be present.

concentration and type of flammable atmosphere, as well as in terms of the extent of the space.

i)
Tanks containing flammable liquids having a flash point of 60°C (140°F) or below.

Holds or enclosed cargo spaces containing cargoes that are likely to emit flammable gases

27.3.3(e) Heated Fuel Oil Storage Tank (2021)
The area within 3 m (10 ft) of the outlet of the vent pipes of Fuel Oil Tanks (e.g., fuel oil settling
and service tanks) where the tanks are heated and the length of the vent pipes from the tank top to
the vent outlet is not sufficient for cooling the vapors to below 60°C.
